_doc: clinic-receipt — the collapse, on the page's own receipt (SPEC-V1 §7.2).
After an agent-held booking, the side-by-side receipt renders the agent lane's count from the
page's trusted-event counter. Headless, the by-hand lane stays '-' (Chrome's date picker blocks
CDP entry — see clinic-manual-tax), so this asserts the agent half exactly: one trusted input.
The hand-vs-agent pair on one screen is the human demo's beat; each half is proven separately.
